subject: AWS listing: onboarding flow & hero headline audit
messages:

To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com

Subject: AWS listing: onboarding flow + hero headline — quick audit?

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the intro — attaching our current draft of the AWS product page copy and two hero image variants (CR-AWS-listing-draft-v3.docx, hero_variants_v2.png). We want to move to private offer + co-sell badge but first need to make sure the product page language and the onboarding flow meet AWS catalog rules and co-sell readiness.

Two quick asks:
- Can you do a short audit on the hero headline + one-liner (we suspect it's too technical) and a suggested customer-facing rewording?
- Quick checklist on onboarding steps so our devs can confirm AMI/container links, trial vs private offer messaging, and required usage examples.

We need internal sign-off from marketplace by Sep 14 to hit our launch window. CC'd AWS in case there are hard listing constraints we should be aware of.

Attachments: CR-AWS-listing-draft-v3.docx, hero_variants_v2.png

Thanks,
Sarah Chen
Head of Cloud Partnerships
CloudRetail Inc

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah@cloudretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Date: 2026-09-08T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing: onboarding flow + hero headline — quick audit?

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending the draft. Looping in Ben (GTM) and Mateo (Partner Ops) to help with the co-sell/playbook side. Quick read-through notes below; I’ll follow up with an inline marked-up doc by EOD tomorrow.

Hero + one-liner (initial thoughts)
- Current: "Low-latency model serving for enterprise inference." — feels product-forward, but not customer-outcome oriented.
- Suggestion A: "Ship AI features faster with predictable latency and lower inference cost." (benefit first)
- Suggestion B (short): "Reliable, cost-efficient inference for production AI."

CTA clarity
- Replace ambiguous CTAs like "Get started" with explicit offers: "Start 14-day self-service trial" OR "Request a private offer & co-sell" (choose one and surface the other as secondary).

Onboarding flow checklist (high-level)
- AMI/container registry links + sample deployment script (required).
- Clear trial limits (token quota, time window) and billing transition language.
- Technical SKU mapping + measurement events for usage examples.
- Co-sell opt-in/information (partner contact + regional availability).

Ben/Mateo — any must-have sales phrasing or co-sell gating we should include on the page?

Kimberly Park
Senior Marketplace Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Sarah Chen <sarah@cloudretail.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing: onboarding flow + hero headline — quick audit?

Thanks Kimberly — quick sales notes from my side.

Copy and positioning
- Lead with a customer outcome for the hero (Kimberly's suggestions are good). Add a two-line subhead that calls out "predictable pricing" or "SLA-backed latency" only if you can substantiate it on the listing.
- Use the one-liner in the sales play: "Reduce inference cost per API call by up to X%" — only if you have internal benchmark numbers. If not, keep qualitative: "reduce inference costs with intelligent batching and caching."

Co-sell specifics
- Page should surface a partner contact CTA: "Contact our marketplace partner manager to co-sell" (link to HubSpot contact form).
- Add an explicit step in the MAP: Partner kickoff (week 0), co-sell enablement kit delivery (week 1), pilot qualification (week 2–3), launch & marketplace ops sign-off (week 4).

Sample one-liner for the listing (short):
"High-throughput LLM inference with predictable performance and lower unit cost."

Sarah — can you confirm if CloudRetail will offer a free trial SKU or require Private Offer only? That changes the CTA wording.

Ben Carter
GTM Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah@cloudretail.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Date: 2026-09-09T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing: onboarding flow + hero headline — quick audit?

Thanks — adding an ops checklist and a few technical notes (high level).

Marketplace readiness checklist (items we need from CloudRetail):
- AMI/container image host + integrity checksum; startup script for verification.
- Clear SKU mapping: trial SKU vs billed SKU; example usage limits for trial.
- 3 listing screenshots (hero, product UI, pricing matrix) — sizes per AWS spec.
- Usage examples (2–3 short customer scenarios) with measurement events we can map to telemetry.
- Support contact + SLA summary to include in the listing notes.

Co-sell enablement steps
- Confirm co-sell contact (name/email) and regional coverage.
- Provide a short 1-pager playbook we can use in field enablement.
- Complete the AWS co-sell opt-in form (link below).

Doc links: AWS co-sell opt-in portal: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/co-sell-opt-in
HubSpot deal for mapping: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/CR-2026-0914

I attached a lightweight listing-qa-checklist.xlsx with the required fields I typically validate. Please return the AMI and screenshots by EOD Mon (Sep 13) so we can iterate.

Mateo Alvarez
Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Sarah Chen <sarah@cloudretail.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing: onboarding flow + hero headline — quick audit?

Thanks for including legal. Two quick redlines to flag before we publish:
1) Data retention claim: if the listing asserts "no customer data retained beyond the session" we need CloudRetail to confirm and provide a short data processing note (how logs/inputs are stored, retention windows, and encryption at rest).
2) Support/SLA wording: do not state an SLA or "SLA-backed" uptime unless there is a signed support contract with specific uptime commitments. Instead use "enterprise support options available" and link to the support page.

Please add a short note under technical details that points to the customer-facing data processing statement and a support contact for pre-sales. I can draft the two short legal blurbs and attach as a redline to the doc — would like sign-off by Sep 14 to keep the launch timeline.

Attachments: legal-redline-AWS-phrases.txt

Olga Petrov
Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
